audience: roofing and exterior contractors that run jobs, estimates and to-dos in RoofLink

useCases.title: Review jobs by status, sales rep or creation date
useCases.text: List jobs, or search them by status, sales rep, creation date or zip code. Open one job for its customer and dates.

useCases.title: Find a customer and read their contact details
useCases.text: List customers filtered by sales rep or region, then open one customer for contact details and addresses.

useCases.title: Review an employee's to-dos
useCases.text: List to-dos filtered by employee, job, priority and completion. Open one to-do for its notes and job.

useCases.title: Create a to-do for an employee on a job
useCases.text: Create a to-do for one employee, linked to a job. A repeated call creates a second to-do, so check the list first.

useCases.title: Mark a to-do complete or open again
useCases.text: Mark one to-do as complete, or open it again. Repeating the same call gives the same result.

useCases.title: Check the calendar and crew work orders
useCases.text: List calendar events by date range, and the work orders of one crew by start or completion date.
